title: MrFallBoy´s Vanilla+
description: MrFallBoy’s Vanilla+ is a lightweight Fabric modpack that keeps Minecraft close to the original Vanilla feeling while improving visuals, atmosphere, quality of life, and survival gameplay.
body:
****Optional recommendation: Physics Mod Pro by Haubna can be installed separately for enhanced block, mob, item, liquid and visual physics. It is not included in this modpack and must be downloaded from the official Physics Mod website, Patreon or Ko-fi.****

MrFallBoy’s Vanilla+ is a lightweight Fabric modpack that keeps Minecraft close to the original Vanilla feeling while improving visuals, atmosphere, quality of life, and survival gameplay.

It includes shader support, improved animations, small comfort features, farming additions, pipes, gravestones, and performance-focused mods for a smoother and more polished experience without turning the game into an overloaded tech or magic pack.

More mods and improvements may be added over time as the pack continues to grow.
